place-hand.caption: Side of your hand. Place two fingertips on the soft outer edge, between your little finger and wrist. Use a light touch.

place-crown.caption: Top of your head. Place two fingertips at the centre of your crown.

place-brow.caption: Inner eyebrow. Where your eyebrow begins, beside the bridge of your nose.

place-sideEye.caption: Side of your eye. Find the bone beside the outer corner. Stay on the bone.

place-underEye.caption: Under your eye. On the bone below your eye, in line with the pupil.

place-nose.caption: Under your nose. In the space between your nose and upper lip.

place-chin.caption: Chin crease. Below your lower lip, above your chin.

place-collar.caption: Below your collarbone. About an inch out from the centre, just below the bone.

place-arm.caption: Under your arm. Reach across to your side, about four inches below your armpit.

tension-setup.caption: Even with this tension, I can be kind to myself right now.

worry-setup.caption: Even with this worry, I can be kind to myself right now.

overwhelm-setup.caption: Even with this overwhelm, I can be kind to myself right now.

grounding-setup.caption: My feet. The room. This moment.

grounding-reminder.caption: My feet. The room. This moment.

tap.caption: Tap with me. A light touch.

rest.caption: Let your hands rest. Notice how you feel now.
